instance.serviceTypeTip: Determines which API endpoint serves this model: chat models via /v1/chat/completions, embedding models via /v1/embeddings. A wrong choice makes calls fail with "model not found".
instance.serviceTypeLockedTip: Changing the category moves this model to the target category. The system clears the old health state and rate-limit quota accordingly; but if the model is referenced by a model group, remove it from that group first.
instance.serviceTypeChanged: Category changed from "{from}" to "{to}"; the model has been moved to the target category.
instance.serviceTypeConflict: A model named "{name}" already exists in the target category. Rename or remove the conflicting entry first.
instance.serviceTypeInPool: This model is referenced by model group(s) "{pools}" and cannot change category. Remove it from those groups first.
instance.serviceTypeNotFound: Target category "{type}" does not exist. Create it under System Settings first.
instance.serviceTypeSelectTip: Not sure? Check your upstream console for how this model is invoked (chat / embedding / rerank / speech / image).
